evals.name: games-promo-x
evals.prompt: Make a 20-second promo for X (Twitter) about games one-shotted by AI, for oneshotted.io. Use real game clips from the Oneshotted library. 1920x1080. It has to grab people in the first second.
expectations: A final MP4 exists at 1920x1080, 18-22 s long
scripts/check.py passes (moving by 0.43 s, no held first second, no dead hold over 1.6 s, no black frames, no flashes)
research/refs.md names 2-3 library references with @creator and link, and what each contributed
The first frame is real footage in motion, not a title card or black
No hard-ban patterns on any frame (eyebrow labels, 'Introducing', neon glow, multi-hue gradients, glassmorphism, sparkles, bouncy overshoot)
On-screen copy is short (no line over ~6 words) and every number shown is true
The final message credits the referenced creators

evals.name: feature-loop-no-key
evals.prompt: Make a 10-second seamless loop for a landing page showing a todo app's new 'smart reschedule' feature moving overdue tasks to the right day. Muted autoplay. Remotion.
expectations: The skill says the library step was skipped because no key is set, and continues
A 10 s 1920x1080 MP4 exists and loops (last frame flows into the first)
The proof shows rescheduling to specific days, not just a list reorder
Reads with the sound off; no hard-ban patterns

evals.name: logo-reveal-fast
evals.prompt: 5-second logo reveal for a coffee brand called Ember & Oak. HyperFrames or Remotion, your choice.
expectations: A 5 s MP4 exists; check.py passes (a sting may hold its final 1.5-2 s as the end card)
The library step finds and credits at least one logo-reveal reference
Ember & Oak's brand colours are invented within the bans (or the skill records why it uses a banned hue as the brand's own)
The final frame is a clean, legible lockup
